text:
Iris: Quick sync 1: can we agree a lightweight claim gate for SI co-sell + hardware bundles going into marketplace launches? Need something low-friction for Q2 pilots. @Priya @Omar-SI
Max: yes. Keep it simple: short claim TTL, a single canonical CSV, and a Friday adjudication slot. Avoid long email chains.
Priya: agree. Suggest default TTL = 3 business days, auto-extend to 7bd if SI sets tech_ownership=true. Also add claim_priority (hot/warm/cold).
Omar-SI: SI ask: if we delivered a POC or integration code, that should be high priority and extend TTL. We also want `integration_repo` and `demo_recording` links in the manifest.
Jenn: marketing/legal constraints: marketplace asset freeze = 5 business days before publish. Legal needs 72h for logo signoff. Timeline must be in the manifest.
Iris: ok combine: claim CSV + adjudication window Fridays 11am PT. Ops runs nightly dedupe and posts conflicts.
Priya: CSV headers proposal:
```
global_account_id,account_name,region,region_owner,sales_owner,si_org,hw_vendor,claim_ts,claim_ttl_days,claim_reason,proof_url,tech_ownership,integration_repo,claim_priority,marketplace_sku,asset_freeze_flag,legal_clearance
```
Max: add `canonical_global_owner` to prevent double-regional claims and `confidence_pct` from ops dedupe.
Omar-SI: adjudication flow idea: auto-resolve if confidence_pct>85 and only one tech_ownership=true. If both tech_ownership=true escalate to triage. First-claim wins otherwise.
ops-bot: job scheduled: "si-claim-dedupe" nightly 03:30 UTC. Report URL: https://redwood.internal/ops/reports/si-claims/2823456789 :robot_face:
Jenn: marketing will require `marketing_blurb_status` and `sku_mapping` fields so we can QA listings quickly.
Iris: pilot roles: Priya = manifest owner, Omar-SI = SI liaison, Jenn = marketing approvals, Max = ops automation, Iris = final arb. Pilot window = two weeks around launch.
Max: I'll add a simple webhook to push CSV diffs to #partnerships-review and send a Slack thread link in the CSV.
Priya: will drop the template + two example rows by EOD.
Omar-SI: I'll attach example integration repo and demo link in 30m.
Jenn: draft asset checklist incoming. Legal: remember partner logo addendum.
Iris: thanks all 1: let's keep the charter small for pilot: reduce churn, speed approvals. If adj disputes need exec time, tag me with `@Iris +urgent`. :pray:
